columns.weight: Numeric [0, 0.20] — target portfolio weight (after STR_1715 overlay applied)
columns.sleeve_A_in: Logical — TRUE if name selected from STR_1715 sleeve
columns.sleeve_B_in: Logical — TRUE if name selected from M6 Ensemble sleeve
columns.combined_score: Numeric — sleeve-z combined score (diagnostic, NA for CASH)
columns.score_A: Numeric — STR_1715 score_eff (NA for B-only and CASH)
columns.score_B: Numeric — M6 alpha_score (NA for A-only and CASH)
columns.cash_residual: Numeric — STR_1715 overlay cash share at sig_date (consistent for all rows of that date)
columns.in_returns_panel: Logical — Ticker present in returns_monthly_panel at sig_date (PIT listing universe proxy)
columns.as_of_date: Date — duplicate of sig_date for Backtest Contract schema parity
